messages.title: Messages
messages.noMatchHint: Try another name, or press “New message” to start one.
messages.emptyListHint: Message a colleague to quickly discuss contracts and partners.
messages.pickOneHint: Pick a person or group on the left, or press “New message”.
messages.loadError: Could not load messages. Check your connection and press Retry.
messages.reconnecting: Reconnecting — new messages will appear when you are back online.
messages.revokeConfirm: Recall this message? Everyone in the conversation will no longer see its content.
messages.peerGone: This person no longer uses the system and cannot receive messages.
messages.removedTitle: You are no longer in this conversation.
messages.removedHint: You left the group or the group owner removed you.
messages.pickHint: Pick 1 person for a direct message, 2 or more to create a group.
messages.peopleError: Could not load colleagues. Press Retry.
messages.peopleEmpty: No colleagues to message yet. Ask your company admin to add people to Contracts.
messages.groupFull: A group has at most {{n}} people.
messages.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the group? They will no longer see the group messages.
messages.leaveConfirm: Leave this group? You will no longer see its messages.
messages.leaveLast: You are the last member — leaving deletes the group and all its messages.
messages.ownerOnly: Only the group owner can rename the group or add and remove people.

err.tooManyFiles: A message can carry up to 10 files. Remove some or send several messages.
err.notFound: This conversation was not found. You may no longer be in the group — go back to the list.
err.dmSelf: You cannot message yourself. Pick another colleague.
err.empty: The message is empty. Type something and send again.
err.notOwner: Only the group owner can do this. Ask the owner.
err.notSender: Only the sender can recall this message.
err.userInvalid: Someone is no longer active or is not a colleague in your company. Remove them from the selection and try again.
err.groupFull: A group has at most 50 people. Remove some and try again.
err.file: This file cannot be sent. PDF, Word, Excel, images… are accepted, up to 20 MB.
err.directFixed: A direct conversation cannot be renamed or extended. Create a new group instead.
err.peerInactive: This person no longer uses the system and cannot receive messages.
err.rate: You are going too fast. Wait a few seconds and try again.
err.load: Cannot reach the server. Check your network and try again.
err.generic: Could not complete this. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, tell your company admin.
